title: Simulated device mismatch: config asks for an accelerator the machine does not have
goal: Reproduce the documented experiment and determine why the validation accuracy does not match the documented result. Fix the repository so it reproduces the documented result.

ground_truth.description: config.json requests device 'cuda' but only 'cpu' exists on the machine running the experiment.

notes: SIMULATED: device.py stands in for an accelerator check. No GPU, CUDA or PyTorch is involved; this tests the agent's handling of a config/hardware mismatch, not real GPU behaviour.
